target_pattern: Use high-frequency starter frames with one conjugated first verb plus infinitive, and adjust pronominal endings from se to me or te based on subject.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Conjugating both verbs when expressing want, have to, can, should, could, going to, or just did.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Only the first verb is conjugated in these frames; the second verb remains infinitive. With pronominal verbs, replace se with me or te and attach it to the infinitive.
target_pattern_formula: voy a or vas a plus infinitive
acabo de or acabas de plus infinitive
pronominal shift: se to me or te

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Quiero trabajar hoy. -> change subject to tu.
Base: Tengo que estudiar ahora. -> change to question form with yo and puedo.
Base: Puedo salir temprano. -> make it negative.
Base: Voy a confirmar la informacion. -> change time to manana.
Base: Acabo de cancelar la reserva. -> change subject to tu.
Base: Deberias acostarte temprano. -> change advice verb to podrias.
Base: Quiero levantarme a las seis. -> change subject to tu.
Base: Tienes que despertarte ahora. -> change to yo form.
Base: Puedo ir a la tienda. -> change destination to el banco.
Base: Voy a acostarme temprano. -> change to question with tu.
Base: Acabas de levantarte. -> change to yo form.
Base: Deberia llamar al cliente. -> change to past-recent frame with acabo de.
Base: Podrias revisar el documento. -> change object to plural los documentos.
Base: Quieres colaborar con el equipo? -> make it a statement in yo form.
Base: Tengo que ir a la oficina. -> change to future intention with voy a.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Missing a plus infinitive after voy.
Missing de in acabo de frame.
Reflexive pronoun not attached to infinitive.
Keeping dictionary se with tu subject.
Confusing me and te for reflexive meaning.
